review_type: LLM semantic review of complete actual per-record prompts, student_work and assistant targets; bounded CPU arithmetic cross-check; no human certification
scope: All 19 grade4/5 source_samples present in this bounded 34-sample diagnostic. Not a corpus-wide semantic certification or estimate of training-data error prevalence.
criterion: Flag confirmed false mathematical claims, wrong requested-task answers, invented data/student work, unsafe hint disclosures or invalid missing-data handling. Do not label uncheckable content, AI origin or merely terse wording as wrong.

abacus_boundary_resolution.separate_33_reason: 7*4+5=33 with m restricted to1,2,4. No abacus answer33 occurs in the actual abacus JSON record.

nonblocking_observations: Some missing-unit guards identify the absent unit through initial_guidance without an explicit question sentence; clearer clarification requests would improve pedagogy, but they correctly abstain and contain no confirmed mathematical error.

The hint rows are stage-appropriate guidance/check prompts and withhold final answers. No claim is made that these bounded hints cover every instructional need or that corpus-wide repeated generic hints are harmless.
